audience: Pi, OpenCode, Grok Build, Kilo, and future harness users
problem: A capable model can still behave badly when the surrounding harness edits too soon, skips research, mishandles waits or context, or claims success without verification.
solution: Use rich observable ChatGPT Work/Codex transcript evidence to identify useful control behavior, then transfer and test it across different harnesses and models through small prompt, context, capability, checkpoint, and only-if-earned runtime changes.
mechanism: keep raw transcript and account data local while deriving structural reference evidence
measure complete observable trajectories rather than only tool order
run Pi, OpenCode, and Grok Build in the same small development slice where possible
record exact model, provider, harness, control version, environment, and repetition
change one behavior hypothesis at a time and automatically compare before versus after
use prompt and context control first; add runtime state only when repeated evidence earns it
keep Kilo Codex v0 and the existing replay/scorer work as a positive-control baseline and history

evidence.claim: The repository has full-corpus, originator-separated Work/Codex structural analysis.
Paired Kilo/OpenCode Codex-mode prompts and an R1-R6 scorer exist as v0 behavioral-control prototypes.
A 22-thread matched replay scaffold with development, holdout, and morph concepts exists but full outcome replay remains incomplete.
The owner accepted the model- and harness-agnostic fast-loop operating direction on 2026-09-21.
The first active v2 slice is the baseline Pi/OpenCode/Grok Build replay with no new intervention initially.

boundaries: This is not a SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, Harbor, or public coding-exam project.
Raw JSONL, SQLite, prompts, transcript bodies, credentials, private account exports, and user artifacts stay out of Git.
ChatGPT Work behavior is reference evidence, not a literal tool sequence or prose script every harness must copy.
The project is model- and harness-agnostic.
A general runtime state machine is not a prerequisite; runtime enforcement must be earned by measured failures.
Architecture-only progress without an immediate measured signal, evaluator capability, or behavior result is out of scope.

preferred.control layer: prompt, context, capability, checkpoint, and earned runtime controls
preferred.baseline: v0 or current measured comparison condition
preferred.status: shipped, experimentally supported, planned, or unknown
